info.about: The date_opened of the customer's earliest checking account. It sets the referrer's tenure. Read it from the records, not from what the customer remembers.
The customer's past referrals, with their statuses and dates

steps.do: Ask the customer for identifying details. Look up their record by the name, email or user id they give.

args.customer_name: the name the customer gives (or use get_user_information_by_email with their email, or get_user_information_by_id with their user id)

steps.do: Confirm that at least 2 of the customer's date of birth, email, phone and address match the record. If they do not match, share no account information and do not continue.
Get the current time. It is used for the verification log and for every day count below.
Log the verification record.
steps.if: the customer gave at least 2 matching identity values

steps.do: Unlock the account lookup tool.
steps.if: the customer is verified
steps.quote: Use get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 to retrieve the bank accounts (checkings, savings) for a customer.

steps.do: Retrieve all of the verified customer's bank accounts, including account_type, account_class, status and date_opened.
steps.quote: Checking eligibility requirements for opening new accounts (existing account status, balances, account tenure, number of accounts)

steps.do: Retrieve every referral the verified customer has made, with statuses and dates.
steps.quote: Track the timing of your last two successful referral bonuses before sending additional referrals.

steps.do: Find the earliest date_opened among all of the customer's checking accounts (personal or business, whatever the class). Tenure in days = current date minus that date. Ignore savings accounts and ignore the date the customer recalls.
steps.quote: This threshold is calculated from when you first became a Rho-Bank checking customer—specifically, the date your earliest checking account was opened.

steps.do: If the customer has no checking account, or tenure is below the lowest business checking minimum (45 days, Sky Blue), tell them they are not yet eligible to refer for any business checking account and on which date they will reach 45 days. Give no product recommendation or bonus terms. Do not submit anything. Stop.
steps.quote: Every referral program requires the referrer to meet a tenure threshold before participating.

steps.do: Count the referral bonuses the customer received (status COMPLETE) in the 9 days before the current time, across all checking account types. If there are 2 or more, a new referral would be denied automatically. Tell the customer they must wait until the oldest of those is more than 9 days old, and give that date. Do not recommend or submit. Stop.
steps.quote: If you attempt to receive more than 2 referrals in a single 9-day period, the third referral (and any subsequent referrals in that window) will be automatically denied.

steps.do: Ask for each referred-party fact not yet given: product kind (business or personal), planned qualifying deposit and whether it is new money, whether the party is new to Rho-Bank, whether they share the customer's address, whether the primary signer already owns a Rho-Bank business account, whether the signer is 18 or older, and the company formation date.
steps.if: the referrer passed check_min_tenure and check_rolling_window
steps.quote: The referred person must be a new Rho-Bank customer with no existing checking, savings, or closed accounts within the past 12 months.

steps.do: Explain that the referral would be rejected, give the reason, and stop without submitting if any of these holds: the referred party has had a Rho-Bank account in the past 12 months; the party is registered at the customer's address (compare with the address from verify_lookup); the business's primary signer already owns a Rho-Bank business account; or the signer is under 18.
steps.quote: For business accounts: The referred business must have a different primary owner than any existing Rho-Bank business account, based on the SSN of the primary authorized signer.

steps.do: Using the business checking referral table in rules, list every account for which all of these hold: (a) tenure from compute_tenure is at least the account's minimum; (b) the planned new-money deposit is at least the account's qualifying deposit; (c) the customer's referrals for that account this calendar year are below its annual cap; (d) for Sky Blue only, the business is within 4 years of formation. Recommend the one with the highest referrer bonus. The account type the customer already holds does not matter.
steps.if: all earlier checks passed
steps.quote: Consequently, holding one account type does not prevent you from referring someone to a different account type, as long as the duration since your first account meets or exceeds the program's stated minimum.

steps.do: If no account meets every condition (for example, the planned deposit is below every qualifying deposit the tenure allows), explain which requirement is not met and stop without submitting.
steps.if: pick_account finds no qualifying account
steps.quote: REJECTED — The referral has been denied (e.g., rolling window limit exceeded, ineligible referral).

steps.do: Give the recommended account and both bonus amounts: the referrer's bonus and the referred business's welcome bonus. Also give the qualifying deposit and its window. If the customer asks about a higher-bonus account they hold but whose tenure minimum they have not met, explain that tenure is measured from their earliest checking account, whatever account type they hold. Add the conditions: the deposit must be new money and stay in the account at least 30 days after the qualifying period; closing within 90 days can reverse the bonus; the bonus cannot be combined with other promotions.
steps.if: pick_account found a qualifying account
steps.quote: The qualifying deposit must remain in the account for at least 30 days after the qualifying period ends.

steps.do: If the top account is Beige, tell the customer that Beige referrals are arranged through their dedicated relationship manager.
steps.if: the recommended account is Beige
steps.quote: Contact your dedicated relationship manager for referral materials

steps.do: The customer submits the referral with their own user_id and the recommended account's name in '<Name> Account' form (for example 'Hunter Green Account').
steps.if: the customer agrees to the recommendation
steps.quote: Someone with a Navy Blue account can refer others for World Blue, True Blue, or any other checking product—provided they've met the duration requirement.

steps.do: Confirm the submission. If the result is REJECTED, explain the likely reason (rolling window or referred-party eligibility). If it is ERROR, tell the customer a system error occurred and they can try again later.
steps.quote: ERROR — A system error occurred during the referral process.

rules.rule: Referrer tenure = days since the earliest date_opened among the customer's checking accounts. The account type held is irrelevant.
rules.quote: The type of account you currently hold is irrelevant to this calculation.

rules.rule: At most 2 referral bonuses in any rolling 9-day window, across all checking account types. A third is denied automatically and cannot be reinstated within that window.
rules.quote: This limit applies across all checking account types; referrals from different accounts count toward the same 9-day cap.

rules.rule: After a rolling-window rejection, wait until the oldest qualifying referral is more than 9 days old.
rules.quote: If your referral was rejected due to the rolling window limit, you must wait until your oldest qualifying referral is more than 9 days old.

rules.rule: The referrer and the referred person cannot share a registered address.
rules.quote: The referrer and referred person cannot be registered at the same address.

rules.rule: The referred person must be 18 or older. Only the Light Green Account allows minors with a guardian.
rules.quote: The referred person must be 18 years or older, except for the Light Green Account which allows minors with a guardian.

rules.rule: The qualifying deposit must be new money, not a transfer from another Rho-Bank account.
rules.quote: The qualifying deposit must be new money and cannot be transferred from another Rho-Bank account.

rules.rule: If the referred account closes within 90 days of opening, the bonus may be clawed back.
rules.quote: If the referred account is closed within 90 days of opening, the referral bonus may be reversed (clawback provision).

rules.rule: The referral bonus cannot be stacked with other new-account promotions.
rules.quote: The referral bonus cannot be combined with other new account promotions or sign-up bonuses.

rules.rule: Beige: referrer bonus $500, referred bonus $350, minimum tenure 120 days, qualifying deposit $100,000 within 120 days, cap 15 per calendar year. Handled through the relationship manager.
rules.quote: Referrer tenure requirement: 120 days since opening your first checking account with us.

rules.rule: True Blue: referrer bonus $350, referred bonus $250, minimum tenure 90 days, qualifying deposit $50,000 within 120 days, cap 15 per year.
rules.quote: The account age threshold is 90 days, calculated from when you opened your oldest checking account.

rules.rule: World Blue: minimum tenure 90 days, qualifying deposit $25,000 within 90 days.
rules.quote: You must have maintained checking account status with Rho-Bank for at least 90 days

rules.rule: World Blue: referrer bonus $300, referred bonus $200, cap 12 per calendar year.
rules.quote: $300 for each successful referral

rules.rule: Lime Green: referrer bonus $200, referred bonus $150, minimum tenure 90 days, qualifying deposit $15,000 within 90 days, cap 12 per year.
rules.quote: You must have maintained checking account status with Rho-Bank for a minimum of 90 days.

rules.rule: Hunter Green: referrer bonus $175, referred bonus $125, minimum tenure 60 days, qualifying deposit $10,000 within 90 days, cap 10 per year.
rules.quote: A minimum relationship duration of 60 days as a checking account holder is required.

rules.rule: Cobalt Blue: referrer bonus $150, referred bonus $100, cap 10 per calendar year.
rules.quote: You earn: $150 per successful referral

rules.rule: Cobalt Blue: minimum tenure 60 days, qualifying deposit $7,500 within 90 days.
rules.quote: Your eligibility: To participate, your earliest-opened Rho-Bank checking account must have reached 60 days of age.

rules.rule: Navy Blue: referrer bonus $100, referred bonus $75, minimum tenure 60 days, qualifying deposit $5,000 within 90 days, cap 10 per year.
rules.quote: To qualify: The referred business must open a Navy Blue account and deposit at least $5,000 within 90 days of account opening. Referrer eligibility requires having been a Rho-Bank checking customer for 60 days or more.

rules.rule: Sky Blue: minimum tenure 45 days, qualifying deposit $10,000 within 90 days.
rules.quote: Your eligibility: Referrers must meet the 45-day tenure threshold based on their banking history with Rho-Bank.

rules.rule: Sky Blue: referrer bonus $150, referred bonus $250, cap 8 per year. The referred company must be within 4 years of formation.
rules.quote: Confirm your company is within 4 years of formation.

draft.done_when: Either (a) the customer was told they cannot refer now, with the reason (tenure, rolling window, referred-party eligibility or deposit) and when they can try again, and nothing was submitted; or (b) the agent recommended the highest-bonus business checking account the customer qualifies for today, explained both bonus amounts and the conditions, the customer ran submit_referral for that account, and the agent explained the result.
